name: B10-0222/2025 (PfE) – Execution spree in Iran and the confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the execution spree in Iran and confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Iran. It condemns the death sentences given to two activists, Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani, and the many executions in Iran. It asks Iran to review their cases with fair trials and to free detained European Union citizens and political prisoners. It also criticises the treatment of women and religious minorities, and calls for a ban on Sharia law across Europe.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It concerns Iran's authorities, detained activists, European Union citizens held in Iran, and women and minorities.
- Parliament sends the text to the relevant parties; no further action is set out.
